verified.analysis: This is real, dated, forward and non-macro — a signed definitive agreement with a named counterparty and a Q3-2026 close — so it clears G1/G2 and is not a NONE. But numerator provenance kills the trade rather than the fact pattern: re-deriving the upside from YUMC's own economics instead of inheriting the company's "mid-single-digit accretive 2027-28" framing, the eliminated $62M royalty capitalizes to roughly what was paid, netting perhaps 1-2% of EPS in year one against a $16.9B market cap. Triage's own instinct was right — this is the buy-side of a deal, where the acquirer pays fair value (19.5x LTM by the company's own disclosure) and the seller books the premium; the closing itself is a mechanical non-event with no re-rating mechanism attached, and the stock's 7-week strength is earnings-driven, already harvested, and unrelated to the catalyst. Score capped at 4 on both the derived-upside test and the remaining-capture test; the residual case for owning YUMC is China consumer recovery plus the $1.5B 2026 capital return and ~100%-of-FCF policy from 2027, which is an equity thesis, not a catalyst.

verified.kill_fact: NUMERATOR NEVER REACHES THE COMMON — the line's own waterfall claim is false. On 29-Jun-2026 Zymeworks signed a BINDING definitive agreement to acquire Theravance Biopharma for $17.00/share ALL CASH, ~$929M equity value, closing 2H26 (Theravance 8-K/DEFA14A; PRNewswire 302813088). Against that, ZYME had only ~$270.6M cash/securities at YE2025 plus the $250M Royalty Pharma royalty-backed note (announced 02-Mar-2026, proceeds earmarked "share repurchases, potential strategic acquisitions, extend runway beyond 2028") = ~$520M versus a $929M cash outlay. The $250M Jazz milestone is therefore STRUCTURALLY PRE-COMMITTED to funding an already-signed acquisition — textbook proceeds-use reinvestment, not cash accretion to a $1.60B-cap common. The line's assertion that "the FIP-style waterfall trap does not apply — there is no preferred stack ahead of the common" is a category error: there is no preferred, but there IS a $929M binding contractual claim ahead of any holder benefit, and the line never checked it. VECTOR 7 ALSO MISATTRIBUTED: the de-rate from 28.56 (acceptance day 27-Apr) to 21.81 is not a PDUFA discount waiting to close — it post-dates and tracks the 29-Jun M&A announcement (price sits below both the 50d 24.24 and 200d 23.98), so the market marked ZYME down on capital allocation into a target whose Phase 3 CYPRESS/ampreloxetine had already failed (CVR hands 80% of any ampreloxetine monetization to THERAVANCE holders, not ZYME). The gap to the modeled 27.50 is an M&A discount, not residual catalyst capture, which invalidates the ~26%-up/~1.3x-R/R frame the score rests on. TAIL ALSO OVERSTATED: the Royalty Pharma note cedes 30% of worldwide Ziihera royalties from Jazz AND BeOne until 1.65x (to 31-Dec-2033) / 1.925x thereafter, so the "royalty ramp" the line concedes is slow is also only 70% retained and encumbered by debt — a fact the line omits entirely. WHAT SURVIVES (confirmed primary, hence not a zero): PDUFA 25-Aug-2026 is real, unfired and 21 days forward (Jazz PR 27-Apr-2026, HERIZON-GEA-01, priority review, no AdComm scheduled); the $250M Jazz milestone is contractual and — correcting toward the line — is EXPLICITLY RETAINED by Zymeworks, not pledged to Royalty Pharma (milestones excluded from that collateral); quote verified exactly at 21.81, mktcap $1.6047B (250/1604.6 = 15.6% checks), 52wk high 29.75. The $15M figure is a CORRECTION: primary language totals $15.0M of near-term GEA regulatory milestones across Jazz and BeOne arrangements, not a clean standalone BeOne China NMPA payment (BeOne's NMPA sBLA was only accepted Apr-2026). HIDDEN DISQUALIFIER: Q2 earnings land 06-Aug-2026 with NO conference call — management explicitly suppressed the call pending the Theravance close, so the one disclosure event before the PDUFA carries reduced information and elevated headline risk. Unfired is not unpriced, and cash that is already spoken for is not upside.
verified.analysis: Verified real, dated and forward: the 25-Aug-2026 PDUFA is 21 days out and unfired, the $250M Jazz milestone is contractual rather than derived (so the FIP-style waterfall trap does not apply — there is no preferred stack ahead of the common), and the approval case is strong (positive Phase 3, breakthrough designation, molecule already approved in 2L+ biliary). The residual-capture test passes on the unusual fact that the stock has DE-rated into the event: +17.8% from the 18.52 pre-topline base but -23.6% from the 28.56 close on the acceptance day and -26.7% off the 29.75 high, leaving ~26% to a re-derived 27.50 favorable-resolution value versus ~20% downside on a CRL. What caps this at 6 rather than higher is that approval is close to consensus — so a meaningful share of the $250M is likely already embedded and sell-the-news is a live risk — the milestone is one-time cash rather than a recurring stream (the royalty ramp is slow), the reference R/R is only ~1.3x, and three weeks to resolution is late-arc for a bi-weekly cadence. Not a macro bet. Unverified: cash balance, runway and exact share count (SEC 403, IR timeout), which is the only input that could move the downside floor.
